data.notes: The user asked for an 80/20 approach, so this run used the full 12-search budget and nothing more: one extended search per model plus follow-ups on i20, Kona, Tucson and Ioniq 5 N. Trunk volumes for the main variants are covered. Remaining gaps are null, marked in the notes and listed in notFound. Power values are mostly null because they were not verified. Possibly missing Hyundai passenger cars that were not researched: Bayon (B-SUV, sibling of i20/Kona), i30 5-door / i30 Fastback, Ioniq 6, Santa Fe, Ioniq 9. Bayon is the most obvious same-segment gap. Several values come from secondary sources (ADAC, Auto Bild, Motor1, carwow, AutoScout24) because the Hyundai press kits (hyundai.news) were only found for the i30 Kombi and Tucson Hybrid.
